column1: # Post-game ending sequence: Jenna and Kraden adrift, then Alex arrives.

column3: Kraden... how long\nwill this island drift\nbefore we reach land?{end_wait}
I wish I knew.\nThe current is beyond\nanything I've studied.{end_wait}
You always have\nan answer. Not now?{end_wait}
How can you think\nabout food right now?{end_wait}
I keep thinking\nabout my brother.\nWhere is he now?{end_wait}
I cannot be sure,{pause_20_skippable} but\nthe Venus beacon\nseems to be burning.{end_wait}
I saw it. That light\nis why we're drifting\nout here, isn't it?{end_wait}
{actor_name:1} and his friends\nwere near the beacon.\nI hope they escaped.{end_wait}
There's something\nyou both need to see.{end_wait}
Come with me.\nSomeone is waiting\nfor you both.{end_wait}
